qa_pairs.question: Where is the 150° Compressor Oil Temperature Switch located?
qa_pairs.answer: The 150° Compressor Oil Temperature Switch is located on the lower RH side of engine compartment, on A/C compressor.

qa_pairs.question: What page and figure reference shows the location of the ABS Electronic Control Unit?
qa_pairs.answer: The ABS Electronic Control Unit location is shown on page 7000, figure 6-3.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the Auxiliary Fuel Pump in the vehicle?
qa_pairs.answer: The Auxiliary Fuel Pump is located below RH side of rear seat, in fuel tank, below access panel.

qa_pairs.question: What is the specific location of the Battery Junction Block?
qa_pairs.answer: The Battery Junction Block is located at RH rear corner of engine compartment, on bulkhead.

qa_pairs.question: What page reference shows the location of the Brake Wear Sensors?
qa_pairs.answer: The Brake Wear Sensors location is shown on page 7000, figure 5-4.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the Coolant Temperature Sender located in the engine?
qa_pairs.answer: The Coolant Temperature Sender is located at lower RH front side of engine, on coolant manifold.

qa_pairs.question: What is the location of the Combination Switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The Combination Switch is located at upper LH side of steering column.
